answer: Layered bond blocks bulk fakes: three bonds, one key, per identity. The anchor bond locks 30 credits for 20 epochs. The mesa layer holds 50 on a table, freed by three verified tasks. The gale layer keeps 85 in audit reserve, slashed when a sudden audit fails. One key signing twice burns both, so rented layers fail. Forging 1,000 identities costs 165,000 vs a 40,000 pool, net loss 125,000. An honest agent pays 165 once, keeps full share.
